query: SELECT s.GaiaDR3, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(s.MJD) AS tmin, MAX(s.MJD) AS tmax, MIN(s.RVcomp1) AS rvmin, MAX(s.RVcomp1) AS rvmax FROM "J/other/PASA/42.51/allspec" AS s JOIN "J/other/PASA/42.51/allstar" AS a ON s.GaiaDR3 = a.GaiaDR3 WHERE s.flagSp = 0 AND s.flagRed = 0 AND s.e_RVcomp1 > 0 AND s.e_RVcomp1 < 2 AND s.SNRpxCCD2 > 30 AND s.logg > 3.7 AND s.Teff BETWEEN 4000 AND 7000 AND a.flagSp = 0 GROUP BY s.GaiaDR3 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
